start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter padhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kya pasand hai?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh sunna bahut bhaari lag raha hai. Aap abhi okay hain?
Theek hai, Kabir. Chaliye perimeter ko vegetable patch ke chaaron taraf fencing samajhte hain—fence ki total lambai kaise milegi, aap kya karenge?
